description: Activate, cancel or delete an Auto query. Creating costs 5 credits plus LLM usage, cancel and delete are free. An activated query runs unattended and fires its action without asking again. Per-post X accounts in its tweet conditions are billed on top while it runs.

description.description: Why this was set up, shown alongside the title.

method.description: create activates a new query. cancel stops an active one. delete removes one that has already finished.

query.description: EQL query as a JSON object, not a string, with conditions, actions and expiresIn. auto_build drafts one inside its response text. Actions are notify or webhook: a query carrying a credential, such as a telegram_bot botToken or a webhook signingSecret, is refused.

title.description: Short title shown in the notification when this fires.

name: auto_query_write
title: Write Auto queries
